freshworks-freddy-ai.accessEn: Freddy AI capabilities within Freshworks products (Freshdesk and Freshchat), according to subscription.

pricing.fr: Forfaits Freshworks et modules Freddy AI ; Copilot par agent et Agent IA selon sessions ou packs.
pricing.en: Freshworks tiers and Freddy AI add-ons; Copilot per agent and AI Agent by session or session packs.

kustomer.accessFr: Plateforme CRM de service client Kustomer avec agents IA, automatisation et canaux de messagerie.
kustomer.accessEn: Kustomer customer-service CRM with AI agents, automation, and messaging channels.

pricing.en: Plan subscriptions and AI usage; voice, SMS and WhatsApp may be metered separately.

liveperson.accessFr: Plateforme LivePerson Conversational Cloud pour messagerie, agents conversationnels et analyse des échanges.
liveperson.accessEn: LivePerson Conversational Cloud platform for messaging, conversational agents and interaction analytics.

pricing.fr: Contrats de plateforme et options selon les canaux et capacités ; vérifier les conditions commerciales.
pricing.en: Platform contracts and options by channels and capabilities; confirm commercial terms.

yellow-ai.accessFr: Plateforme Yellow.ai de création et déploiement d’agents IA omnicanaux, avec console et intégrations.
yellow-ai.accessEn: Yellow.ai platform for building and deploying omnichannel AI agents with console and integrations.

pricing.en: Freemium plan for exploring the platform; premium tiers and enterprise pricing on request.

ibm-watsonx-orchestrate.accessFr: Plateforme IBM watsonx Orchestrate pour créer et gouverner des agents IA sur le cloud et en entreprise.

pricing.en: Free trial and paid plans scaled to teams, deployment environments and workloads.

adcreative-ai.accessFr: Application Web de création de visuels publicitaires, de variations de créations et d'analyse.
adcreative-ai.accessEn: Web app for advertising creatives, variants and analysis.

pricing.fr: Abonnements payants et offres entreprise personnalisées ; conditions d’essai à vérifier lors de l’inscription.
pricing.en: Paid subscriptions and tailored enterprise offers; check trial terms at sign-up.

creatify.accessFr: Application Web de génération de publicités vidéo, avatars et créations à partir de produits.
creatify.accessEn: Web app for video ads, avatars and product-based creative generation.

pricing.en: Limited free access followed by subscriptions and generation credits; enterprise options available.

ocoya.accessFr: Plateforme Web de génération de contenu, calendrier éditorial et publication sur réseaux sociaux.
ocoya.accessEn: Web platform for content generation, editorial calendars and social scheduling.

pricing.en: Paid subscription tiers with generation credits and limits; custom plans may be available.

predis-ai.accessEn: Web app for AI marketing creatives, video, image and social publishing; API access varies by tier.

pricing.en: Free trial followed by credit-based subscriptions by volume, brand count and features.

hootsuite-owlywriter.accessEn: Writing and post-generation assistant integrated within the Hootsuite web platform.

pricing.en: OwlyWriter included in Hootsuite plans, with subscriptions primarily billed per user.

buffer-ai.accessEn: AI assistant within Buffer for drafting, rewriting and repurposing social posts.

lumen5.accessEn: Online AI video creator turning ideas, text and articles into videos.

promo-com.accessEn: Web app for marketing video production including PromoAI features.
